title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Discover the unique rituals and recurring celebrations that define student life at CUNY Queens College, from late-night finals fuel to symbolic marches through the campus gates.

cards.title: Marching Through the Main Gate
cards.subtitle: A symbolic entry for new Knights
cards.notes: Join the traditional ceremony where incoming students march through the main gate to symbolize the opening of future opportunities.
cards.short_summary: A symbolic march through the campus main gate for new students during Welcome Day.
cards.evidence_claim: Welcome Day includes a traditional ceremony where new students march through the main gate symbolizing endless opportunities.
cards.source_title: Welcome Day - Student Development and Leadership - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Occurs annually during the fall Welcome Day event for new students.

cards.title: The MidKnight Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Late-night fuel for finals week
cards.notes: Head to the Student Union during finals week for a late-night meal served to students as a collective study break.
cards.short_summary: A late-night breakfast event held during finals week to support students.
cards.evidence_claim: The MidKnight Breakfast is a traditional event sponsored by the Student Association and administration during finals week.
cards.source_title: Large scale and traditional events at QC - Student Development and Leadership - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Held late at night (typically 8:00 PM or later) in the Student Union during finals week.

cards.title: Spring Fest on the Quad
cards.subtitle: The annual end-of-year celebration
cards.notes: Celebrate the end of the academic year with live music, food, and activities on the central Quadrangle.
cards.short_summary: An annual large-scale festival held on the Quad every spring semester.
cards.evidence_claim: Spring Fest is listed as a large-scale traditional program hosted by the College Union Programming Board.
cards.source_title: Large scale and traditional events at QC - Student Development and Leadership - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Annual event held on the Quad during the spring semester.

cards.title: Fall Fest
cards.subtitle: Kicking off the autumn semester
cards.notes: Join the campus community for an outdoor festival featuring student organizations and entertainment to start the fall term.
cards.short_summary: A traditional autumn festival held on campus to welcome students back.
cards.evidence_claim: Fall Fest is a recurring traditional event organized by the Office of Student Development and Leadership.
cards.source_title: Large scale and traditional events at QC - Student Development and Leadership - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Held annually during the fall semester, typically on the Quad.

cards.title: The Monday Mile
cards.subtitle: Walking for wellness with campus leadership
cards.notes: Participate in a community walk led by the College President to promote wellness and kick off Diversity Week.
cards.short_summary: A recurring community walk led by the President to promote campus wellness.
cards.evidence_claim: The Monday Mile is a collaboration with the President's office to kick off Diversity Week.
cards.source_title: Large scale and traditional events at QC - Student Development and Leadership - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Typically held annually to start Diversity Week.

cards.title: Homecoming Step Show
cards.subtitle: A celebration of Greek life and culture
cards.notes: Watch the National Pan-Hellenic Council's annual high-energy performance featuring rhythmic stepping and cultural celebration.
cards.short_summary: An annual step show performance hosted by the National Pan-Hellenic Council during Homecoming.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Pan-Hellenic hosts an annual Homecoming Step Show for students and alumni.
cards.source_title: The National Pan-Hellenic hosts their Annual Homecoming Step Show
cards.access_notes: Held annually during Homecoming; tickets may be required for some venues.

cards.title: Snowflake Social
cards.subtitle: Winter community gathering
cards.notes: Gather with fellow students for a seasonal social event featuring winter-themed activities and refreshments.
cards.short_summary: A traditional winter social event for the Queens College community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Snowflake Social is listed as a traditional program provided by the Office of Student Development and Leadership.
cards.source_title: Large scale and traditional events at QC - Student Development and Leadership - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Held annually during the winter season, typically in the Student Union.

cards.title: Harvestfest
cards.subtitle: Autumnal campus celebration
cards.notes: Enjoy fall-themed activities and community building during this annual harvest celebration.
cards.short_summary: An annual autumn-themed event for students and staff.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvestfest is identified as a large-scale traditional event at Queens College.
cards.source_title: Large scale and traditional events at QC - Student Development and Leadership - Queens College
cards.access_notes: Held annually during the fall semester.

cards.title: Club Day on the Quad
cards.subtitle: The heartbeat of campus involvement
cards.notes: Explore dozens of student organizations and cultural clubs during this massive recruitment fair on the Quad.
cards.short_summary: A major semesterly event where student clubs showcase their activities and recruit members.
cards.evidence_claim: Club Day is a prominent event where over 90 clubs and organizations showcase school spirit.
cards.source_title: Friends, food, and fun: QC club day - The Knight News
cards.access_notes: Held during the 'Free Hour' on the Quad, typically early in the fall and spring semesters.

cards.title: Commencement on the Quad
cards.subtitle: The final walk as a student
cards.notes: Join the massive outdoor graduation ceremony held on the central Quad, a tradition dating back to the college's early years.
cards.short_summary: The official annual graduation ceremony held outdoors on the campus Quadrangle.
cards.evidence_claim: Queens College's main commencement ceremony takes place on the Quadrangle.
cards.access_notes: Held annually in late May for graduating students and their guests.
